next.reason: 1985: collating sequence for nonnumeric keys fixed at the start of SORT, first the SORT COLLATING SEQUENCE phrase, then the program collating sequence. §2023:14.9.40.4 GR5 keeps that precedence ('First, the collating sequence established by the COLLATING SEQUENCE phrase'), and §2023:12.3.6.4 GR13 restates that the program collating sequence applies to sort keys unless the phrase (or a 2023-only SET) overrides it. The separate national sequence and SET apply only to 2023-only features; a 1985 program sorts the same.
